anf_compare.notes: No public-domain English of On Pascha exists (Toura 1941; Daly ACW 54 and Witte's German are copyrighted and were not copied). Sense checked against the locked Witte Greek (and, for 1.94, Victor of Capua's Latin as Witte prints it) and the wording of the cited scriptures.

apparatus: Witte p.126 / PDF 130. 1 L. ca. 7 Z.
Mostly unrestored or heavily restored Greek; English does not fill gaps.

bible_refs.note: Quoted: we know in part… when the perfect comes, what is in part will be done away.
What remains until morning is burned.

pass_a_gloss: [gap] for we know from a part and we prophesy from a part, as the same apostle teaches, but when the perfect comes the from-a-part will be abolished, which he says is to be burned until morning.
pass_b_english: [lacuna] ["for we know in part and we prophesy in part,"] as [the same apostle] teaches, ["but when the] perfect [comes], [what is in part] will be done away," [which he says] is to be burned [until] morning.
source_text: ... ["ἐκ μέρους γὰρ γινώσκομε]ν [καὶ ἐκ μέρους προφητεύομε]ν", [ὡς ὁ αὐτὸς ἀπόστολος διδά]σκει, ["ὅταν δὲ ἔλθῃ τὸ τ]έλ[ειο]ν τὸ [ἐκ μέρους] καταργηθήσεται", [ὃ ἕως] πρωῒ λέγει κατακαίεσθαι·
